units: Targ. Ps. XLVI, 2 (ed. Wil. סִיעֲתָא, read סַיַּעְתָּא).—ס׳ דשמיא, ס׳ מן שמיא divine assistance, providential grant.
<cite ref="Megillah 6b:4">Meg. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>ס׳ מן ש׳ הוא</he> success depends on divine grace (not on man’s work alone); a. e.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 48a:8">B. Mets. 48ᵃ</cite> <he>קרא לא תיובתא ולא ס׳</he> (Ms. F. a. R. 2 … <he>תיובתיה … סַיַּיעְתֵּיה</he>) no argument either against or in favor of his opinion could be derived from the text.
